a.text: Okay, quick update on the kitchen renovation for everyone on the thread. The cabinets arrived yesterday, but two of the upper doors are the wrong shade, so I sent photos to the supplier and they promised replacements within ten days. The electrician finished the under-cabinet lighting and the new outlets by the window, although the one next to the fridge still trips the breaker when the kettle and the toaster run together, so please avoid using both at once until he comes back. The countertop template appointment is on Wednesday at two, and someone needs to be home to let them in; I can be there until three. The plumber says the sink can go in the same day as the countertop if the template goes well; otherwise it moves to the following Monday. For the backsplash, we narrowed it down to the white zellige tiles or the pale green ones, and I would like everyone to vote by Friday so I can place the order before the price change. Also, the old dishwasher is in the garage, and the recycling center only takes appliances on the first Saturday of the month, so it will sit there for a couple of weeks. The painter can start the week after the countertop goes in, but he needs the trim color by Thursday at the latest, so please send me your vote for the soft white or the warm gray before then. Finally, the budget is still about eight percent over, mostly because of the extra lighting, so let’s hold off on the new bar stools for now.

b.text: Okay, quick update on the kitchen renovation for everyone on the thread. The cabinets arrived yesterday, but two of the upper doors are the wrong shade, so I sent photos to the supplier and they promised replacements within ten days. The countertop template appointment is on Tuesday, no wait, Wednesday at two, and someone needs to be home to let them in; I can be there until three. The plumber says the sink can go in the same day as the countertop if the template goes well; otherwise it moves to the following Monday. For the backsplash, we narrowed it down to the white zellige tiles or the pale green ones, and I would like everyone to vote by Friday so I can place the order before the price change. Also, the old dishwasher is in the garage, and the recycling center only takes appliances on the first Saturday of the month, so it will sit there for a couple of weeks. The painter can start the week after the countertop goes in, but he needs the trim color by Thursday at the latest, so please send me your vote for the soft white or the warm gray before then. Finally, the budget is still about 8% over, mostly because of the extra lighting, so let’s hold off on the new bar stools for now.
